centralP0.rule: installed MetaMask-level interoperability only; source, CI, Simulator and ad-hoc evidence do not promote runtime

executionPlan.verification: Standard Wallet E2E execution-plan gate passed for 12 registered products

singleBlocker.summary: No approved execution lease or protected runtime package currently supplies the real Reown project, eligible Apple signing/install identities, approved native test account authority and four exact DApp execution targets required for installed relay interoperability.
singleBlocker.ownerAction: A named Central release owner must issue one path-scoped execution lease and populate the protected native WalletConnect runtime environment. Secret values must never be returned in chat, evidence or the repository.

requiredProtectedInputs.purpose: real Reown Cloud project bound to the production relay allowlist

requiredProtectedInputs.name: YNX_WALLETCONNECT_APP_GROUP
requiredProtectedInputs.purpose: Apple signing-authorized group/keychain access group used by Reown persistence

requiredProtectedInputs.name: YNX_WALLETCONNECT_APPROVED_ACCOUNT
requiredProtectedInputs.purpose: dedicated Testnet 0x account address exposed only after explicit approval

requiredProtectedInputs.name: YNX_WALLETCONNECT_SIGNER_BINDING
requiredProtectedInputs.purpose: existing native Keychain/biometric signing authority reference; never a raw private key

requiredProtectedInputs.name: YNX_WALLETCONNECT_TEST_TX_POLICY
requiredProtectedInputs.purpose: operator-approved Testnet recipient, maximum value and gas boundary

requiredNonSecretReceipts: path-scoped execution lease naming this owner and apps/wallet Apple paths
Reown project allowlist receipt covering the canonical ynxwallet scheme and eligible Apple application identities
iOS development or distribution signing receipt proving the required group/keychain entitlement on an installed physical-device build
macOS Developer ID plus notarization and Gatekeeper acceptance receipt for the installed public candidate
exact first-party DApp URL and exact independently opened Uniswap, OpenSea and Safe URLs
named test operator confirmation for approve, reject, personal_sign, EIP-712, Testnet send and disconnect/revoke actions

frozenIdentity.boundary: Provider RDNS and Apple bundle identifiers are distinct identity fields. This blocker does not rename an Apple target, impersonate MetaMask or authorize a Universal Link/AASA route.

auditBasis: apps/wallet/macos/Package.swift has no Reown package dependency
apps/wallet/ios/YNXWallet.xcodeproj/project.pbxproj has no Reown package reference or product dependency
both iOS build configurations set YNX_WALLETCONNECT_PROJECT_ID to an empty string
Central P0-173 records heavy.owner=null and no execution lease

implementation: pin Reown Swift 2.3.1 and integrate WalletKit/Networking/Sign into both native targets
configure YNX-only metadata, ynxwallet callback routing and signing-authorized persistence without enabling Universal Link
bind only eip155:6423, approved lowercase 0x account, accepted methods and accepted events
route personal_sign, eth_signTypedData_v4 and eth_sendTransaction through the approved native signer binding with explicit user confirmation
surface proposal/request/session state in default-English native UI with working approve, reject and disconnect controls
installedAcceptance: install eligible iOS and macOS candidates and prove cold launch plus second launch
pair first-party DApp and separately pair exact Uniswap, OpenSea and Safe targets through the real relay
capture proposal visibility and both approve and reject without creating authority on rejection
restart both apps and prove session restoration
prove personal_sign, EIP-712 and Testnet send only after user confirmation and receipt readback
prove foreground and cold-start ynxwallet callback delivery
disconnect and revoke, then prove persisted session and account authority are purged

promotionRule: Only the direct installed evidence envelope produced after the single protected runtime package is satisfied may promote runtime. Source, CI, hosted, Simulator, unsigned, ad-hoc, detection, can-open and fail-closed evidence remain non-completion.
